OverviewKey FeaturesSpecifications

Programmable radiator heating control

The TRV06 is a Zigbee 3.0 smart radiator thermostat head for room-by-room heating control on compatible hot-water radiator valves. It features an M30 × 1.5 mm threaded connection, an LED display and power from two AA alkaline batteries.

Set a weekly heating schedule with up to six periods per day. With a compatible Tuya Zigbee gateway, users can adjust temperature settings remotely through Smart Life or Tuya Smart, group multiple TRV06 units in the app, and use voice control through Amazon Alexa or Google Home.

Open window detection closes the valve when the thermostat senses a rapid temperature drop. The TRV06 also features a child lock, a frost protection mode and an automatic valve exercise cycle. For distribution or retrofit enquiries, share your existing valve model and preferred gateway configuration so we can confirm fit and package contents.

Product FAQ

Does TRV06 connect directly to WiFi?

TRV06 uses Zigbee 3.0. Remote app control and voice control require a compatible Tuya Zigbee gateway and the appropriate app configuration.

Will TRV06 fit my radiator valve?

The threaded connection is M30 × 1.5 mm for compatible hot-water radiator valves. Send your valve model or a clear photo so fit and any adapter requirements can be confirmed.

Are batteries and valve adapters included?

TRV06 is powered by two AA alkaline batteries. Battery, adapter and gateway inclusion must be confirmed for the selected package before ordering.

How many heating periods can I program?

Weekly schedules support up to six periods per day. Multiple TRV06 units can be grouped through the app with a compatible gateway.

What does open window detection do?

When the thermostat detects a rapid temperature drop, open window detection closes the valve. The device also provides frost protection and an automatic valve exercise cycle.
